description: Free. Lists by name everything the paid Kitchen Pass tools answer today: diagnose dishes with their symptom wordings, ingredients with answered swaps, yield ingredients with aliases (used by both calculate_yield_and_cost and calculate_amount_to_buy), scaling classes and tip topics, and the food-safety topics that are always refused. Names only, never the answers. Call it before a paid tool when unsure whether a dish, symptom or ingredient is covered. Use section to fetch one part only.
